instruction: Go straight past the pool. Walk between the bar and chairs.  Stop when you get to the corner of the bar.  That's where you will wait.

steps.thought: The pool is on the right and the bar with chairs is ahead. I'll walk forward past the pool toward the bar area.
The bar is ahead with chairs to its left; I need to walk between them toward the bar's corner. I'll advance carefully and re-observe.
I see chairs on the left and the bar counter ahead. I need to advance between the chairs and the bar toward its far corner.
I'm beside the chairs with the bar counter ahead. I need to walk between the chairs and the bar toward its far corner.
I'm right beside the row of chairs with the bar counter visible ahead. I need to edge past the chairs toward the bar's near corner, so I'll turn slightly right to clear the chairs and advance.
The bar counter is ahead-left and the chairs are to the right; I should advance toward the gap between them, then stop near the bar's near corner.
The bar counter is ahead-left and the chairs are to the right; I need to advance through the gap between them and stop at the bar's near corner. I'll take a few forward steps and re-observe.
The bar is ahead on the left with chairs to its right; I need to advance between them toward the bar's near corner. I'll move forward a few steps and re-observe.
The bar's corner is ahead-left with chairs to the right; I need to advance between them toward the bar corner.
The bar's corner is just ahead on the left with chairs to the right; I'm nearly at the gap between them. One or two forward steps should bring me to the corner of the bar.
